description: Find reviewed products by buying guide, type, price, installation, width or room size. Each result has its dated US price, main trade-off, who it isn’t for, and a store link with its disclosure.

limit.description: How many results to return; 10 if not given.

maxPrice.description: Highest US price in dollars. Unknown, withheld and replacement-model prices never pass.

maxWidth.description: Widest the product may be, in inches. Unknown widths never pass.

minRoom.description: Smallest room the product must cover, in square feet. Unknown coverage never passes.

q.description: Product words: a brand, a model or a kind of product, such as "infrared sauna blanket". Health conditions aren’t matched.

type.description: A product type as results give it, such as "smart-ring".

name: search_products
title: Search product reviews
